summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change switched payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so every payment call failed silently (logged only at DEBUG) while /health stayed green.
recommended: Confirm with ops that payments-v2 is reachable and correct before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG.
Add a provider reachability check to the config change process.
